list: A dainty bouquet in a refined vase. 'PREP THE SHOT! I WANT A LOOK AT THOSE FLOWERS!' 'Yeah, yeah...' And so the prop master juices the poor wilting things until they're fresh again with plant revitalizing Arts.

A fully mobile metal HMI lamp plus film cart full of scripts and other junk. In the Script Auction—Wrankwood's signature event—buyers eye synopses and creative minds, and no one can say what anything's worth until the movie pops out.

Studio set wallpaper. Sometimes the whole studio becomes a set to meet a shoot's demands. Sargon's deserts, Sami's icefield shacks, Siesta's sunset beaches... One tastefully painted backdrop is all it takes to bring you anywhere.

Dark red curtains hung on an upright frame. There used to be this 'stuntman' who could blend into his surroundings with just his Arts. Invisibility on demand! He loved scaring the heebie-jeebies out of the rest of the crew during breaks.

A big piece of shoot equipment, all-weather and all-terrain. It's the age of the VFX Artists who conjure explosions, rain, snow, lightning, thunder and more with their Originium Arts. An insane upgrade for movie realism!
A reflector in a lighting rig. Hate constant adjustments? Despise disassembly and reassembly? Just use this one weird trick: 'Applicants with telekinetic Arts preferred'.

One large prop rack to hold it all, actors' painstakingly coordinated outfits included. The majority of Wrankwood costume designers are either Liberi or thickly furred—it primes you with an inimitable insight into hair and feathercare.

Studio set flooring, supremely anechoic so no crew movements pick up on mic. In rare cases, acousticians supplement a barrier of Arts to wall off all sound. Reliable sources say tons of Leithanian graduates apply for the post every year.

Two monitors, one big, one small, so the director can check on any screen, anytime. The big one for the full picture, the small one to spy the details. Feed after feed, painstakingly building Wrankwood's silver screen, dream after dream.
In front of the screen, definitions are made, and beauty is advertised. Behind the screen, there is an endless walk, and dreams hang high above.
theme: A Wrankwood studio as described by Tippi. Are you waiting to find smash success? Nursing dreams of a life of milk and honey? Don't delay! Doesn't matter who you are, 'cause here in Wrankwood, you're the next big star!

list:
You witnessed Tragodia's scepter change hands.
There is no end to the birth of more stories, and no one can specify for sure what an ultimate 'aesthetic' is. He only continues on, towards the pinnacle of the stage.
During the Act or Die event, obtain the free Operator Miss.Christine

You obtained special permission from Miss.Christine to rub her chin, once.
Fluffy and warm... finally you free yourself from work and sink into this wondrous sensation for a long time before coming back to your senses. Somehow your tiredness has vanished, and you feel even a little excited.
During the Act or Die event, spend 4000 Phantoms of the Studio

You found mysterious black shadows scattered all over the film set, and the crew was astonished with your finds.
As you look at Miss.Christine on the camera, leisurely basking in the sunlight and happily enjoying her 'afternoon tea', you know this game will probably continue for a long, long time.
Complete all stages in [Performance Begins] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

You enjoyed watching a play of submission, rebellion, death, and rebirth all entangled together.
Pre-written scripts of the past scatter into the wind, and now he can finally create his own future.
Complete all the content in [Backlot Entertainment Projects] and collect the rewards

You visited dozens of Wrankwood's studio plates.
You saw not only the champagne and finery under leather shoes and high heels, but also how the eyes of people in different positions all light up when a movie hits the screens. That is what Wrankwood is all about.
Activate Cameras a total of 20 times

Every character's expression mixes together like a montage, and you watch the truest tale be told.
Perhaps at the very end, the lime-eyed girl with dimples on her left cheek will dance freely under the camera's lens.
Destroy Lighting Props a total of 30 times

You lamented how drab and cramped this prop room was compared to the glistening dazzle of Wrankwood.
Here a little dream struggles, and with the tiniest leak of light from the film set, pursues the brightest spotlight on the award podium.
Complete all stages in [For Drama, For Eternity] on Challenge Mode

You went through hundreds of emotions and thousands of lives in this drama. Truly a fascinating experience.
Ecstasy, rage, sorrow, hate... The story ends here, but there are still those who yearn and chase after a higher art.
Clear AD-5 with a 3-star rating, and have a Hero's Sidekick engage in mutual combat with a Villain's Minion

You witnessed a futile struggle happen again and again for eternity.
Fabricated joys and sorrows nourish their souls, and they no longer have to consider their feelings. You know this struggle will only lead to naught, so it's best to leave at once.
Clear AD-7 with a 3-star rating, and do not let film thrown by Unhappy Cameramen explode more than 4 times

The insanity of drama has given birth to a false consciousness in dead matter. Fortunately, you have been sober the whole time.
The storm dissipates, and the survivors welcome their new, true lives in the wastes.
set: Act or Die Engraved Medal Set

A set of engraved medals depicting a serial killing case on a Wrankwood film set.
The performance never stops, and the Dithyramb will never end.
